{{Quote|I have helped General Kota before, on Druckenwell, Selonia, and Kuat. Each time, his missions were successful in helping the Alliance.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]|<ref name="TFU2n" />}}
During the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Alliance forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] conducted a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], where they were aided by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].
